definitions.explanation: Not difficult to do or understand. Written as {易|やさ}しい. The opposite of {難|むずか}しい.
Having a mild or caring disposition. Written as {優|やさ}しい.

examples.english: This book is written in easy Japanese.

notes:
やさしい has two distinct meanings with different kanji.

MEANING 1: {易|やさ}しい (easy, simple)
- Opposite: {難|むずか}しい (difficult)
- {易|やさ}しい{問題|もんだい}: easy problem
- {易|やさ}しい{言葉|ことば}: simple words

MEANING 2: {優|やさ}しい (kind, gentle)
- {優|やさ}しい{人|ひと}: kind person
- {優|やさ}しい{声|こえ}: gentle voice
- 〜に{優|やさ}しい: kind to ~

FORMS:
- Adverbial: やさしく
- Noun form: やさしさ

NOTE:
Context usually clarifies which meaning is intended.
